name: Coconut Buns
notes: These are like the Chinese Coconut Buns from Kings Bakery in SF—much beloved by Levi. A tasty “hot crossed buns” surprise for Easter celebrations. Best served warm. Can refrigerate or freeze.

items: Water if needed to make this an icing consistency

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix together: **5½ cups bread flour**, **½ cup sugar**, **1 tsp salt** and **1 Tbsp yeast**.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.body: Add: **2⅛ cups warm milk**, **6 Tbsp melted butter** and **2 eggs**.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.body: Mix, adding flour until dough just pulls away from bowl, then knead until gluten is formed.

steps.title: Divide the dough
steps.body: Divide into 24 balls (or 32 for smaller serving size).

steps.title: Rest and roll
steps.body: Rest for 10 minutes, then roll into approximately 3×5-inch ovals, keeping the dough covered with saran wrap to prevent drying out.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: While dough is rising, prepare filling. Mix together: **2 cups shredded coconut**, **1⅛ cups butter, melted** (2 cubes, + 2 Tbsp), **¾ dry milk powder**, **¾ cup sugar**, **6 Tbsp flour** and **¾ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Fill the buns
steps.body: Place 1 heaping Tbsp of filling on each disc of dough, optimally in a bit of a log, then form into an oval bun and place in a 10×12 oiled pan, 12 rolls per pan. If making smaller buns, adjust the amount of filling and number of rolls per pan.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.body: Cover and let rise for about 30-40 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare the toppings
steps.body: During the second proving, prepare the egg wash (**1 egg**, **1 Tbsp heavy cream or milk**), the sesame seeds (**2 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds**, optional) and the topping (**4½ Tbsp melted butter**, **6 Tbsp flour**, **3 Tbsp powdered sugar**, and water if needed to make this an icing consistency).

steps.title: Brush and pipe
steps.body: Brush risen buns with egg wash, sprinkle with sesame seeds, place topping in a ziploc bag with a corner cut out, and apply a line of topping along each short end of the buns, or for a hot-crossed bun look, along one short end, and then center of the length of the buns, in a cross.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in a 350°F oven for 20+ minutes until golden.
